title: torch compile does not handle out_dtype argument in torch.mm (but succeeds with torch.bmm)
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

```
import torch

A = torch.rand((1024, 1024), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
B = torch.rand((1024, 1024), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)

@torch.compile
def linear(weight, input):
    return torch.mm(input, weight, out_dtype=torch.float32)

linear(A, B)
```

Output:
```
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0] failed while attempting to run meta for aten.mm.dtype
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0] Traceback (most recent call last):
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0]   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/dist-packages/torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py", line 2717, in _dispatch_impl
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0]     r = func(*args, **kwargs)
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0]   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/dist-packages/torch/_ops.py", line 829, in __call__
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0]     return self._op(*args, **kwargs)
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0]   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/dist-packages/torch/_prims_common/wrappers.py", line 309, in _fn
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0]     result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
E0918 18:39:52.630000 1234802 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:2721] [0/0] TypeError: meta_mm() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 were given
```

If the torch.compile is commented out, it works.

`torch.bmm` has the same functionality and works.

```
import torch

A = torch.rand((1, 1024, 1024), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
B = torch.rand((1, 1024, 1024), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)

@torch.compile
def linear(weight, input):
    return torch.bmm(input, weight, out_dtype=torch.float32)

linear(A, B)
```
